mentions.name: Delightful new CRM
mentions.description: A new CRM built to compete with the major incumbent platforms, with the explicit goal of being genuinely delightful to use instead of a necessary evil. It will include thoughtfully designed AI features that go beyond a glorified chatbot.
mentions.problem: Business owners the author has helped set up CRMs find them much to be desired and view them as a necessary evil; the challenge is whether a CRM can be delightful to use.
mentions.source_excerpt: we're building a new CRM to compete with some of the big players. I tried very hard to avoid doing this, but I've helped enough business owner friends set up CRMs to realize there's MUCH to be desired. My goal is to create a CRM that people rave about - something that is very rare.
